source.title: Ulster Herald, 21 May 1949, p. 5 ("Four contests in Omagh rural election")

source.check: Original citation restored 6 Nov 2026 (the 5 Nov verification had moved it because of a text-cleaning fault).

note: Triennial election of the 19 electoral divisions of Dungannon rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Retiring members were nominated in seventeen divisions and two new members came in, Mrs. M. A. Stevenson at Bernagh and J. Nimmons at Granville. The only contest, at Meenagh between Frank M'Grath and A. P. M'Grath, has no printed result in the papers consulted, so it is not listed here. Returned unopposed.
